originals.citation: Yang, B., & Lester, D. (2003). Buying books online: Follow-up. Perceptual and Motor Skills.

quote: In a replication study, purchasing books online by 137 state college students was predicted by computer/Internet skills.
notes: Self-replication; only the authors' 2003 'Buying books online' paper is on the list. An earlier original Yang & Lester study may exist but is not cited here.
